notes:
Summary: enterprise evaluation focused on Dedicated reserved GPU pools across 3 regions (us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1). Primary ask: predictable throughput + clear failover headroom and measurable latency SLOs.

Key customer fragments / CRM-style bullets:
- Use case: live dispatch chat (95th pctl latency target) + periodic large-batch embeddings for route modeling.
- Throughput target: ~2k req/s aggregate during peak; regional split expected 60% us-east, 25% us-west, 15% eu-west.
- Latency SLOs requested: 95p < 120ms for chat (up to 512 tokens); p50 < 50ms for routing inference.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to reserve for predictable unit cost but asks for demonstrable cost/throughput tradeoffs; looking for a 12–18 month ROI window.
- Failover strategy: warm standby set of GPUs in secondary region (hot rack fraction ~20%) + automatic routing policy with cross-region fallback; need clear RTO/RPO targets and egress cost estimate.
- Headroom planning: customer wants 25% buffer above steady-state peak per region to cover AZ failures + burst traffic; prefer headroom expressed both in GPU count and token/s.
- Preferred SKUs: evaluating A100-80GB reserved pools; would accept H100 if price/throughput attractive. Ask: Redwood to provide per-SKU benchmark for target sequences (128/512 tokens) and batching assumptions.
- Observability requirements: per-model 95p/99p latency, per-route token cost, KV cache hit rates. Audit logs and SSO mandatory.
- Quote request: initial draft requested for 3-region reserved plan + an alternative single-region+burst plan for cost comparison.

Direct quotes/comms snippets:
- "We need guaranteed headroom for holiday spikes and a clear SLA if region fails — credits only help if we can prove failover meets latency targets." (VP Eng, 2026-02-23)
- "Show us worst-case egress costs; cross-region fallback can't surprise procurement." (Finance lead)

reserved_gpu_plan: Proposal A (preferred): Reserved pools in us-east-1 (40 x A100-80GB), us-west-2 (16 x A100-80GB), eu-west-1 (10 x A100-80GB). Each region includes 25% warm headroom (~provisioned but throttled to standby). Cross-region failover policy: automatic routing to nearest region; warm caches maintained via periodic KV syncs. Proposal B (cost-focused): Centralized us-east-1 reserve (60 x A100) + autoscale burst capacity in other regions; higher cross-region egress. Need Redwood to quantify p95 latency under Proposal B at 2k req/s with 512 token avg.
